THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No : ඉඅ/5/1/295/(1). Ministry of Tourism and Lands Ref. No. : 4-3/4/2021/LRB/233. I hereby give notice, under Sub–section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following Lands/ Servitudes which are required for a public purpose. Purpose of the Acquisition : Acquisition of the allotments of low lands to the government lying between Sri Maha Vihara Mawatha and Titus Gunathilake Mawatha adjacent to Cyril Janz Mawatha- Panadura for the purpose of creating a Water Reservoir, Water Pond/Pool and for the construction of Linear Park, Walkway and a Vehicle Parking lot.

Description of the Lands / Servitudes to be acquired : Boundaries for the below mentioned allotments of lands in total extent about 1.2807 Hectares depicted as Lot No 1 to 8 in the Folio No. 01 of Block No. 02 of the Cadastral Map No. 530047 dated 19.02.2024, made by the Superintendent of Surveys - Kalutara situated in No. 682 B Atambagoda Grama Niladhari Division at Divisional Secretary's Division - Panadura in Kalutara District, Western Province. 01.
